spanish: Y dijo Balaq a Bilam: Anda ahora, te tomaré a lugar otro; quizá enderezará en ojos de Dios, y lo maldecirás a mí desde allí.

findings.issue: The entreaty interjection is rendered as ahora, which can add a temporal sense the token does not state.
Qal cohortative 1cs with a 2ms suffix is smoothed to the future indicative; the speaker still takes the addressee.
Qal imperfect 3ms of ישׁר is stative (be straight/right/pleasing). enderezará is causative (make straight) and changes stem force.

notes: The other clauses keep the packet’s person, number, participants, and proper nouns.
